# SBFB factory — app-authoring agent index

> The Factory app-authoring capability: master anime.js (motion) + daisyUI (on
> Tailwind v4) inside the sealed SBFB iframe, gated by a deterministic CSP scan.
> This index points an agent at the rank-1 sources it must read to author or
> review a sealed-iframe app **without hallucinating**. Since Sprint 80 it also
> indexes the **Operator control-plane API** (loopback, outside the sealed
> iframe) — a distinct sub-domain with its own section below.
>
> **Status: PROVISIONAL where it counts.** The CSP gate, the two knowledge packs,
> and the daisyUI starter template are LIVE and hermetically tested; the
> end-to-end in-vivo journey (real author → publish → cross-peer render) and the
> *generative efficacy* of the prompt-kind / Ollama copilot are **`Not evidenced`**
> — plumbing wired and tested, never measured in-vivo.
>
> **Caveat cardinal — lint statique ≠ garantie runtime ; connaissance consommée,
> jamais autoritaire** (0 verdict PASS).
>
> **Truth Stack** (trust the higher rank on conflict):
> `repo files > .planning/active/ > commits > prompts > chat`. A fact absent from
> rank-1 (a repo file) is **`Not evidenced`** — do not assert it. `.planning/` is
> an in-flight pointer, not a durable anchor.

## Start here (agent contract)

- [WIRING_SPEC.md](./WIRING_SPEC.md): contract-dense, source-anchored wiring spec — the sealed-iframe contract, the gate, the prompt-kind, the context-pack, INVIOLABLE invariants. Read this first.
- [FACTORY_GATES.md](./FACTORY_GATES.md): the 11 Factory gates; FG-CSP-authoring (static scan + assumed false-negatives) and its runtime net (self-check viewer).

## Gate primitives (rank-1 source)

- [csp.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/src/csp.rs): the single CSP source of truth — policy is `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/csp.rs:BLOB_SERVE_CSP`, the `'none'` directives are `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/csp.rs:none_directives`, the only absolute-URL exceptions are `crates/nexus-core-rs/src/csp.rs:CSS_URL_ALLOW`.
- [gates.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs): the deterministic, non-delegable static scan `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:run_gate_csp_authoring` (the policy is never re-hardcoded — a cross-crate anti-drift test pins coverage of the `'none'` directives).
- [process.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/process.rs): the closed prompt-kind registry `crates/sbfb-factory/src/process.rs:PROMPT_KINDS` and the `crates/sbfb-factory/src/process.rs:app-authoring` entry.
- [operator_server.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs): the context-pack handler `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:handle_context_pack` surfaces `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:authoring_knowledge` (hashed path refs, never inlined).
- [template_engine.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/template_engine.rs): the starter `crates/sbfb-factory/src/template_engine.rs:DAISYUI_TEMPLATE` (vendored UMD + build-time `app.css`).

## Runnable examples (compiled / exact)

- [csp_contract.rs](./examples/csp_contract.rs): the six exfil-critical `'none'` directives + the absolute-URL allowlist; compiled+run by [factory_csp_contract.rs](../../crates/nexus-core-rs/tests/factory_csp_contract.rs). Drift in the policy → red build.

## The fiche an agent receives

- [app-authoring.md](../../prompts/agent/app-authoring.md): the CSP-safe authoring doctrine (consumed and displayed, never authoritative) distilled from the two packs.

## Operator control-plane API (loopback, hors sealed-iframe)

*The Operator front (Sprint 80 greenfield, `tools/factory-operator/`) is a
distinct runtime that READS these loopback routes — that makes them §6.12
frontier primitives, indexed here since the S80 closure. They are NOT part of
the sealed-iframe contract (the Operator serves outside `BLOB_SERVE_CSP`).
Human-readable contract summaries: [REFERENCE.md §Operator control-plane API](./REFERENCE.md).*

- [auth.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/auth.rs): bearer root of trust `crates/sbfb-factory/src/auth.rs:AUTH_HEADER` (`x-sbfb-token`); browser fallback cookie `crates/sbfb-factory/src/auth.rs:OPERATOR_COOKIE` (`sbfb_operator`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict) carrying the per-boot `crates/sbfb-factory/src/auth.rs:session_secret` — never the bearer.
- [operator_server.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs): cookie bootstrap `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:handle_bootstrap` (GET `/?token=<hex>` → Set-Cookie + 303, shipped `a5ace8d`); working-tree diff route `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:handle_git_diff` (shipped `bb35d39`); live gates route `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:handle_gates` (shipped `ed00b4a`); chat SSE route `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:handle_chat_stream` and the hand-forged sixth wire event `crates/sbfb-factory/src/operator_server.rs:sse_gate` (shipped `6991d51`).
- [sprint_history.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/sprint_history.rs): the Rust-computed diff producer `crates/sbfb-factory/src/sprint_history.rs:working_tree_diff_data` — envelope `{head, unstaged, staged, truncated}`; the diff is NEVER recomputed in JS.
- [gates.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs): idempotent producer `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:gates_live_data` (no publish scan on GET); status enum `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:GateStatus` (exactly five snake_case values, no aggregate); view structs `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:GatesView`, `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:GateEntryView` (key = (gate, status)), `crates/sbfb-factory/src/gates.rs:GateIssueView` (`line` is null as of S80).
- [llm_bridge.rs](../../crates/sbfb-factory/src/llm_bridge.rs): the five serde SSE variants `crates/sbfb-factory/src/llm_bridge.rs:StreamChunk` (tag `"type"`); with the forged `requires_gate` that makes SIX wire event types.
- TS consumers (linked, outside the rank-1 source-ref scope): [streamChunk.ts](../../tools/factory-operator/src/lib/streamChunk.ts) (hardcoded 6-type union), [useTokenStream.ts](../../tools/factory-operator/src/lib/useTokenStream.ts) (fetch+ReadableStream, first-terminal latch, never EventSource), [operator.ts](../../tools/factory-operator/src/api/operator.ts) (session/send/stream client).
